notes.title: ⚔️COMBAT OVERHAUL UPDATE⚔️
notes.notes:
[h1][b]■ [/b]Updated version[b]: v0.6.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]This is the development team of [b]IfSunSets[/b]![/p][h3][b]⚔️ A brand-new Combat Update has arrived in IfSunSets! ⚔️[/b][/h3][p]In this update, we’ve introduced a new combat system along with various improvements and fixes.[/p][p]Check out the new content that truly lives up to the name of the [i]Combat[/i] update in [b]IfSunSets[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/5b5687c29ddbcdf1842995e193e0de6aa3cb044b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ [/b]Important Notice[/h2][h3][b]Please go to Settings → Input Settings and perform a Key Reset.[/b][/h3][p]Due to upcoming changes for the [b]Controller Update[/b] and key mapping adjustments following the [b]Combat System overhaul[/b],
we highly recommend that [b]existing players reset their key bindings[/b] in the settings before continuing the game.[/p][p]We’re working to ensure that all key assignments function smoothly as soon as possible.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Translation polishing for additional content is currently in progress.[/b][/h3][p]With the addition of various new dialogues, some translations may be incomplete or imperfect.[/p][p]We will update the polished translations as soon as possible.[/p][p]Please keep this in mind while enjoying the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ ⚔️[/b]Combat Overhaul Update Contents[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1.Fairy System Overhaul[/b][/h3][h3]Fairy skills have been reworked.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/8166ece4a820e0269710dbb84969e493511394ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/2e6897f05346db6b9cacabab1769efc319b3f9d6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/82c12b4688c619dab8f9fc9c6bedf4d5e7deaa00.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fairies can now be managed through a new skill menu, allowing for a wide variety of builds.[/p][p]Depending on how you arrange their skills, fairy projectiles can act as homing arrows,
or deal area damage when their shield breaks.[/p][p]Customize your fairy skills to match your own playstyle![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.Phantom Limb[/b][/h3][h3]The '[i]Phantom Limb[/i] system' has been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ba37a78f25fbe5d0fe3243c500b449fd1bc39611.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6e425803509f2bde8b76ce05dadba37f24eaad29.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fairies are helpful on their own,
but they can also possess your hand to lend you their power.[/p][p]This is the [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/p][p][i]Phantom Limb[/i] transforms your hand into a shield or a wire,
unlocking unique skills and actions.[/p][p]Press [b]T[/b] to transform, [b]Ctrl[/b] to use standard actions,
and [b]Q[/b] to activate Phantom Limb-exclusive skills.[/p][p]Experience a whole new layer of combat with the [i]Phantom Limb[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Phantom Limb: Shield[/b][/h3][h3]Introducing the [b]Shield Mode[/b] of [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/724fb9c5e6f58fb048580621f5c83540e5267c19.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/2fd1849fc387e6cbf91605ee2a84b760ac2681d1.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Phantom Limb: Shield[/b] is perfect for players who prefer a defensive combat style.[/p][p]The shield protects you from knockback caused by charge attacks,[/p][p]and its parry ability offers a brief window to counter with massive damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Phantom Limb: Wire[/b][/h3][h3]Introducing the [b]Wire Mode[/b] of [i]Phantom Limb[/i].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6e2bb1ee47896a8ffd38683ffc99466b2328114a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f87dc9ff3c06c3c7d99d5c4aa9952f13bb7270e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Phantom Limb: Wire[/b] is ideal for players who enjoy fast-paced, aggressive combat.[/p][p]Press [b]Ctrl[/b] to shoot the wire—if it hits a monster, you can pull it toward you,
or launch yourself toward the target instead.[/p][p]Surrounded by too many enemies? [/p][p]Use the wire to isolate and drag a specific one right to you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Stability and Execution[/b][/h3][h3]The concepts of [b]Stability[/b] and [b]Execution[/b] have been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fb035fcf6b8d3cf52c40c948510ff4b608fa0d59.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/acab28921175a8843dc7cfbf4c4089ff7c1c70c3.gif"][/img][/p][p]All enemies have a stat called [b]Stability[/b].[/p][p]When you attack them, the white gauge decreases—this is their Stability.[/p][p]When an enemy’s Stability is fully depleted, they enter an [b]groggy[/b] state.[/p][p]At this moment, the enemy becomes vulnerable.[/p][p]This is your chance to strike![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/4e3ee9681473f6924caab8b90a3f9039bf463f58.gif"][/img][/p][p]When enemies enter the [b]groggy[/b] state and you have a melee weapon equipped,
you can approach them to attempt an [b]Execution[/b].[/p][p]A special icon will appear when you get close to an [b]groggy[/b] enemy.
Press the attack button while this icon is displayed to trigger the Execution animation.[/p][p]Executions deal powerful damage and will become a key strategic element in your combat![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Player Attack Overhaul[/b][/h3][h3]New attack types are now available for the player.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b515e61f867eac7da2b551616005a7faf8c93654.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/85ddd4cba895d69445679512dc433cb1b3ef4df9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Tired of just mashing the attack button?[/p][p]We’ve added more variety to the player’s attack options![/p][olist][*][p]Basic attack with a simple click[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy attack with [b]Shift + Click[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Jump attack with [b]Jump + Shift + Click[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p]These three attack types offer a more tactical combat experience.[/p][p]Also, dodge roll animations have been improved to smoothly match your movement direction.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]7.Monster Improvements (Behavior, Detection, Assassination)[/b][/h3][h3]Monster AI has been improved, and a new detection system has been added.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9fb08403f4d5aebac86773da6c57bc841a448b99.gif"][/img][/p][p]Gone are the days when monsters had eyes in the back of their heads and instantly countered with a charge attack the moment you got close.[/p][p]Now, monsters will patrol, rest, and only engage after spotting you and assessing the situation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c76c68a5cf4a8fced1ee4782765fdd9f0bc57aec.gif"][/img][/p][p]With the AI improvements, monsters now truly have “eyes”![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/954acb1b7c2d18b20a4a813ce4b1b653ef1adaf0.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/18cdf9eda6c9c7d33e350393bfe4bc04e14218f0.gif"][/img][/p][p]Monsters now have a clear field of vision and will search for anything that enters it.[/p][p]If the detection eye fully opens, it means the monster has fully spotted you.[/p][p]Sneak up from behind and become a legendary assassin of [i]Luminora[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ General Update Contents[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Armor , Weapon Stand[/b][/h3][h3]So we added new furniture items have been added: the [b]Armor Stand[/b] and the [b]Weapon Stand[/b].[/h3][p]You can now showcase your gear and easily swap between displayed equipment and what you're currently wearing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/057b6d879ec8b32d9cddffbb09887ec3a90a547b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/66547dffb8e59388506a63c4ccf19886e8c8981a.gif"][/img][/p][p]In future updates, you’ll often find yourself needing to swap gear depending on the situation—
to stay warm, explore the ocean, or counter specific monsters with the right weapon.[/p][p]To prepare for that, we’ve added a new structure: the [b]Armor Stand[/b] and [b]Weapon Stand[/b]![/p][p]But these aren’t just for display—
they let you preview the expected stats when wearing the gear,
and instantly swap your current equipment with the displayed set.[/p][p]Decorate your home with stylish gear stands and get ready for anything![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.Story Collection[/b][/h3][h3]Note items can now be added to your [b]Story Collection[/b].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/23bc9f84e5a42d539abb6dd98f0f9ba80b02090f.png"][/img][/p][p]By popular request, notes can now be added to your [b]Story Collection[/b]![/p][p]Once you've read a note, it will automatically be registered in the collection.[/p][p]But don't worry—the note won’t disappear.[/p][p]That would be inefficient, right?[/p][p]After it's registered, feel free to dismantle the note and collect useful materials![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ [/b]Other Update Contents[/h2][list][*][p]All fuel-consuming structures now have an On/Off toggle function.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e960483cb151c437c3a68e49f159c4d96b336cc2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New furniture items featuring monster head decorations have been added.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/df6cee2a151eae539de16ef3faa0168ac5af8396.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Damage balance for all weapons has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fairy dialogue has been revised.[/p][p](Look forward to the upcoming story updates!)[/p][/*][*][p]The dialogue display system for NPC interactions has been updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Upcoming Added notes.notes:
[b][h1]■ Update Version:: v0.5.0[/h1][/b]

Hello,
This is the IfSunSets development team.
The new update, "Life," has been released!
Check out the new content that matches the theme of "Life!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/5d612e4d4493a8990e25ef9e1efc9a317438aa15.png[/img]



[h2]■ Important Announcements[/h2]
[b]1. We have identified an issue where certain antivirus programs create firewalls that interfere with game access.[/b]
If you are unable to connect to multiplayer, we recommend closing your antivirus software and restarting the game.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Thank you for your understanding.


[b]2. We had no choice but to reset all boss respawn timers to fix a respawn bug.[/b]
Players who had only three days left for a boss respawn have also been affected, so please keep this in mind while playing.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

[b]3. The If Sunset prologue has been updated.[/b]
The prologue offers a preview of what you can experience in the main game.
Please note that some content is restricted in the prologue, unlike the main game.


[h2]■ Key Updates for "Life"[/h2]


[h2]Farming[/h2]
Farming in IFSS has been completely revamped!
Enjoy a more user-friendly UI, a greater variety of crops,
and new buildings to make farming even easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/42e1516799b9d73df31d236d88a99b8f4faa184a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 17 new crops have been added.
[*] 17 new seeds have been introduced.
[*] Attribute fruits that grant buffs based on their properties have been developed.
[*] Crops now grow based on in-game days rather than real-time progression.
[*] Crop growth time is displayed in the UI when aiming at planted crops.
[*] Soil moisture levels (whether water is sufficient or lacking) are now displayed in the UI when aiming at farmland.
[*] Fertilizer status (whether the soil has fertilizer or not) is now displayed in the UI when aiming at farmland.
[*] "Ktuga Resonator" has been added—a device that emits energy to activate automation structures.
[*] "Seed Generator" has been added—it converts crops into seeds. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Sprinkler" has been added—it automatically waters the field in the morning. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Energy Farm" has been added—it automatically harvests crops in the morning and stores them in a chest. It requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] "Streetlight" has been added—it emits bright light by receiving energy from the Ktuga Resonator.
[*] "Delivery Box" has been added—it automatically sells stored crops in the morning.
[/list]



[h2]Livestock[/h2]
Animal friends are coming to IfSunSets!
Manage their happiness and obtain new items from them.
And if necessary, you can also harvest meat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/84af8474bb8f20eafab569544d8c8b8377bdfece.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f3037462d343ad7106e81e90eff7a93389f2598e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9be3df98b67c8fcbe3d43c271ac9fb852d83a6b3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new livestock system has been developed in IfSunSets.
[*] A total of 5 adult animals and 5 juvenile animals have been added.
[*] Animals can be raised by registering them in feeding troughs and chicken coops.
[*] Animals can be purchased from Laura, or if two adult animals of different genders are registered, they can produce offspring.
[*] Juvenile animals can grow into adults once they accumulate enough growth points.
[*] Animals can be butchered to obtain meat and bones.
[*] Each animal, when happy enough, will produce special items through unique behaviors.
[*] Sheep produce wool.
[*] Pigs produce various types of mushrooms.
[*] Cows produce manure, which serves as fertilizer for farming.
[*] Dairy cows produce milk.
[*] Chickens produce feathers, and hens will lay eggs if a rooster is present.
[*] Extremely happy hens may occasionally lay golden eggs.
[*] All animals have special variants that produce unique items.
[*] Animals can be enclosed by constructing fences around them.
[*] All animals can be given names.
[*] Hitting an animal decreases its happiness.
[*] Chicken feed, called "Grain Mix," can be crafted with 2 wheat or purchased from NPCs.
[*] Hay, the feed for sheep, pigs, and cows, can be obtained by growing Timothy grass or purchased from NPCs.
[*] New livestock equipment sets have been added to improve efficiency: Apprentice Livestock Gear and Professional Livestock Gear.
[/list]


[h2]Fishing[/h2]
A new fishing bait system, fishing points, new fish species,
and a fish farm that allows fish to multiply are being added in the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6105ef1880875267fa7d1a80e74593e27def0d9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f2d62756fcaf2e20911842375e8eedc93e726497.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fishing in IfSunSets has been revamped.
[*] Fish now spawn appropriately in rivers, seas, and ponds.
[*] Special fish that can only be caught at night have been added.
[*] Bait has been introduced.
[*] If bait is in your inventory, you can switch it using the "R" key, just like swapping arrows.
[*] A new "Fish Farm" has been added, where placing two of the same type of fish may result in one additional fish appearing the next day.
[*] A "Matter Converter" has been added, which transforms trash into a random general material item overnight. The Matter Converter requires a Ktuga Resonator to function.
[*] Two new fishing rods have been added.
[*] Nine new fish species have been added.
[/list]



[h2]Research Notes[/h2]
The Research Note System is being updated!
Register items, earn new rewards, and upgrade your life in IfSunSets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0982f7dcf285796f839b9451b258de3af6f0e080.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/6089cd2be3d4512a0e1dff72713e2fcc8b579a6f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Research Notes have been added to IfSunSets.
[*] They can be accessed by talking to Laura, Logan, and Aiden.
[*] There are three types of research notes: Crop Research, Ichthyology Research (Fish Study), and Animal Research.
[*] By providing the requested items, players can earn experience points and unlock new blueprints.
[*] As the research level increases, both difficulty and rewards will grow.
[*] Completing all research notes will grant a final reward.
[/list]



[h2]Construction[/h2]
94 new interior furniture items are being added in bulk!
Furniture can be purchased from NPCs or crafted directly.
Decorate your home beautifully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/bcbbe0625dd4a9978f1a9c1102714dcb37098def.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 1x1 stairs have been adjusted to align in a straight line, allowing seamless connections.
[*] 1x1 cubes and 2x2 cubes can now be placed on the ground.
[*] Logic optimization has been improved.
[*] The appearance of some module types has been updated.
[*] A total of 94 new furniture items have been added for home decoration.
[*] Having furniture in your home now provides buffs that assist in exploration.
[/list]



[h2]Music Performance[/h2]
A Guitar Bench construction has been added, allowing you to play beautiful music.
The Guitar Bench can be crafted at the workbench, placed in the world, and interacted with.
Play your favorite music freely!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/f6a28187c30715adc92df4f938dde7684802a53b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A guitar system that allows freeform playing has been added!
[*] To use the guitar, craft a "Guitar Bench," place it in the world, and interact with it.
[/list]

notes.title: Differences between Beta and Early Access Release version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
[b]The release of the Early Access Version for IfSunSets is almost here.[/b]

[h2]New features + many improvements[/h2]
We have been hard at work and used your beta test feedback to improve the game, give our players more options and fix diverse bugs.
Players who tried out our Beta or played the Prologue Demo before will experience a lot of improvements.
From the new options to customize your playthrough, over an overhauled Skill System to changes in combat.
[h2]Multiplayer [BETA] (Up to 2 players)[/h2]
There is also one change between the Open Beta and the Release Version of the Early Access we sadly have to announce today.
[b]The multiplayer on release of Early Access will allow up 2 players.[/b]
During the Beta Test, there have been many complaints and inquiries regarding the multiplayer.
So we put our focus on fixing these issues and addressed over 800 bugs!

However, with improving the quest progress and various new features in IfSunSets, new issues occurred which make the multiplayer more unstable if more than two players take part in multiplayer. 
Therefore, we had to reduce the number of players until we can resolve this issue after the Early Access Release.
From the deepest of our hearts, we want to apologize for this.

We want to be transparent and be clear, that at release of Early Access the Multiplayer will still have some issues left and will be in Beta state. Multiplayer improvements are our highest priority right now and we work every day on improving the multiplayer experience.

[b]Now we will discuss the improvements from Beta to Early Access Release of IfSunSets[/b]

[h1][Contents][/h1]
[h2]Skill System Overhaul:[/h2]
The entire skill system of the game has been revamped and the skill tree has completely changed. 
You will be able to improve your character in various ways which allows different playstyles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/92507c874ae2e441f39272b95bb80fc0cdaea960.png[/img][list]
[*] The new Skill System allows way more flexibility!
[*] We are also introducing Special Attacks for different weapons, which will make the combat more fun!
[*] The Balancing will be also improved. [i](Balancing changes are made with community feedback in mind.)[/i]
[*] More details coming soon!
[/list][h2]Improved Night System:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We added a new reason to explore the island at night, while we kept the intensity of the combat during that time!
[*] different gameplay improvements which allow a more enjoyable battle system
[*] more details about the improved Night System will come tomorrow, so stay tuned.
[/list][h2]More Traps:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New turrets, which fire bullets at monsters have been added.
[*] We are introducing traps, which push enemies away to prevent them from coming too close.
[*] Many more new traps are coming
[/list][h2]Lore Video sequences:[/h2]
Video sequences have been added to introduce the Lore of IfSunSets. 
You can watch this video when starting a new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/46ab3f9aec021108ee117c5dbdf682d210a0c596.png[/img]
[h2]New Game Modes:[/h2]
There are now three difficulty levels available when starting a new game:
[b]Easy, Medium and Hard![/b]
There are two more modes available where players can customize their playthrough the way they want.
If you don't want monsters to appear at night, use the SAFE NIGHT MODE. 
If you want to edit everything in the game, use the CUSTOM MODE. Create your own world!
[h1][System][/h1]
[h2]Steam Achievements:[/h2]
Steam achievements have been created! 
There are currently 11 achievements you can get, but we plan to add more in the future.
[h2]Credits added:[/h2]
You can now see the credits, where the people who worked on the game are listed.
Including the developers, our partners and other people we are thankful to.

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[list]
[*] We have addressed several key issues causing Fatal Errors which were reported during the beta test. 
If Fatal Errors occur again, please report them, and we will definitely resolve these issues as well.
[*] Fixed issues where certain elements in the tutorial were not pre-checked.
[*] Fixed a bug with the fairy skill "Blifia Bomb" that prevented the skill from activating in specific situations, causing it to get stuck.
[*] Resolved the Ultra Black Shadow Bug, which made all shadow deep black.
[*] Fixed a bug where items disassembled from the hotbar would be removed but remain equipped, allowing for infinite use.
[*] Corrected an issue where items would drop on the ground instead of being obtained if the inventory was full, even with available hotbar slots.
[*] Fixed various bugs occurring at the puzzle before the boss fight 
(such as issues with saving or problems interacting with the puzzle).
[*] Fixed a problem where all items would disappear when respawning after death and loading a save in front of the gravestone.
[*] We have addressed many different bugs which were reported via Discord, Steam and our survey during the Beta Test.

[h3]That is everything for now![/h3]
We want to thank everyone who gave feedback during the beta once more and we will work hard during the early access period to improve the gameplay, fix issues, add new features and much more.
We are listening to our community and your honest feedback is always welcome!
You can write your feedback on Steam or Discord.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MzSeaZH448

notes.title: Multiplayer Update Now Live!!!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! 
This is the IfSunSets development team. 
We are thrilled to bring you another update announcement. 
We are still working hard on fixing bugs and developing new content. 
We promise to continue doing our best in the development, and we are excited to share the details of this update and hotfix with you. 


[h2]Major Changes: 
The Multiplayer (Beta) is now available!!![/h2]
Exploring the Luminora Island on your own might make you feel a bit lonely from time to time.
Now you can team up with fellow pirates! Arr!
[b]You will be able to test the Beta of our multiplayer[/b] [strike]until August 18th 2024!
So we hope you all play the Multiplayer (Beta) with other pirates during this time![/strike]
[i]Edit: You will be able to play the multiplayer part of our Demo for an expanded period of time![/i]
*Please note that multiplayer is still lacking many features and is only in beta for now. 
There are known bugs as well as many bugs which we haven’t discovered yet. 
To be honest, it’s more like a “take a look at multiplayer” situation right now.
If you encounter any errors, bugs, or other unpleasant experiences while playing, please report them via the Steam community page or through our discord-server.
[b]On discord we have a survey prepared for you as well. [/b]
So please let us know what you think about our multiplayer 
We value all your feedback and will address them promptly! Thank you!

[b]Please check the following important notes:[/b]
The Multiplayer operates on a P2P basis. Since it places a significant load on the host PC, please only attempt it on a PC that meet or exceed the recommended specifications. 
For cross-platform play between players on Steam and STOVE, we use "EOS (Epic Games Online Services)".
For a small developer like us, this is a way, to make online play between users across different platforms possible.
An Epic Games account will be required to use multiplayer.

You can play the Multiplayer (Beta) using the following method:
Step 1: Select Multiplayer (Beta) in the main menu.
Step 2: Sign in with your Epic Games Account.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c9867968957c7964de57d0f2f38497c354e840a2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/988ff1803184760643d24d6bda77168e8ac17ae0.jpg[/img]
Done!
After that you will be able to create a server or join a Server created by a friend. 

[h3]Changed Keyboard Keys:[/h3]
We have changed the default key bindings that many of you found inconvenient. 
We sincerely appreciate your patience in playing the game despite these issues.
(Attention!) If you had custom key settings before, you might still be using the old key bindings rather than the new ones. 
While not mandatory, we recommend pressing the 'Reset' button in the key settings to enjoy the game with updated key bindings. 
(As a system to update key guides according to custom key settings is still in development, using custom keys may cause confusion.)
With the change in default keys, many bugs are expected, such as issues with key bindings (in options) not being properly applied. We will prioritize fixing these bugs and aim to release a hotfix next week.
Changes:
1.	Inventory key changed from [ I ] to [ TAB ].
2.	Interaction key changed from [ E ] to [ F ].
3.	Due to changes in keys 1 and 2, Blifia’s skill keys are now [ E = Change Skill, Q = Use Skill ].
4.	Added right-click to quickly open the item menu within the inventory.
5.	Functions previously activated by right-clicking the mouse have been changed to double-click.
In Progress:
1.	A system to reflect key changes in the key guide UI.
2.	Persistent key guide UI.

[h3]Content Improvements:[/h3]
- Font Change: The game font has been updated. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/80ccd94aa1e645ba4bf85f70f13fb7818d9af98d.png[/img]
We are still searching for a font that suits the game best.

- Tutorial Improvement: 
The tutorial has been improved and is now better organized with clearer objectives.
We are also working on a feature to check and complete objectives before they appear in the Tutorial-Quest. Please stay tuned!

- Fairy Tab 
UI polishing improvements have been made to reduce the inconvenience of switching between windows. The category order in the Fairy Tab has been reorganized based on importance.

- Increased stages for spike traps and defensive walls
Upgrades are now possible from wood -> stone -> iron.

- Ship Hammer Update 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/251ded45b6b4f77b3c8342737ae0af77d0005848.png[/img]
You can now craft and sail your own boat! We look forward to your magnificent voyages! Underwater monsters, underwater items, and events are not yet available but will be integrated in future updates. We hope you look forward to it! 
PS. Ship hammers can be obtained from someone related to boats!

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
The Spring Whale (explosive whale wave monster) will no longer stop exploding when attacked. 
It must be defeated to stop the explosion. The damage of the Spring Whale explosion has been significantly reduced.

Trap damage in castle dungeons has been reduced by 50%. We apologize for the overly strong damage that affected gameplay enjoyment.

The number of wild boars encountered at the start has been reduced and they have been made weaker. New players should find it easier to handle them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fdc7a7c66aacb6c97fe6fc53a83f38aabf6fa21e.jpg[/img]

The acquisition rate of the oxygen-replenishing item ‘Gill Pool’ has been significantly reduced.

Monsters near the teleportation destination altar have been removed to prevent deaths during loading. You can now teleport with the mind of peace!

Soldier stats have been adjusted.

[h3]Design Improvements:[/h3]
The design and detail work of the jungle entrance has been updated.
Details on the cliff tops have been enhanced in preparation for the glider.
There are various design improvements made in different areas of the game.

[Hotfixes]
[list]
- Fixed a bug where rewards were not received after clearing the Squirmy.
- Fixed an issue where players were moved to the castle after falling through the floor.
- Fixed an issue where players were moved to the castle after falling through the floor.
- Removed the save function from the bed (you can now save anywhere!)
- Fixed a save/load bug related to building ownership.
- Corrected terrain issues where players were blocked by invisible walls.
- Resolved an issue where palm trees could not be planted.
- Fixed a bug where the repair kit’s repair value would suddenly drop to 0%.
- Fixed a bug where the farmer NPC Aiden was not present at Erwen’s defense base.
- Fixed a bug where obtaining the Purification Ring blueprint unlocked the crocodile equipment. (If the same bug occurs, please try to reload the save and report if it happens again!)
- Fixed a bug where wave monsters occasionally stepped on players' heads.
- Fixed a bug where wave monsters sometimes stood still. (It is normal that they do not swim in the sea. We are working on making wave monsters swim underwater.)
- Changed the map display from “Cthugha Stones” to “Cthugha Stone Fragment.”
- Fixed an issue where standing on certain desert terrain caused players to float in mid-air.
- Fixed world holes that occasionally appeared.
- Fixed floating items found in various places.
- Ensured that the location for rescuing Laura is no longer destructible.
- Fixed a bug where some items in Blifia’s bag skill would disappear from the inventory.
[/list]
You are always welcome to give feedback or report bugs on our discord channel.
Follow us on social media channels!

notes.notes:
[h1][b][★Update Note 2024.07.19★] 
[/b][/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/80a29b28b2cbdeec281f8f4fc6b8d91eab2a7122.jpg[/img]


Hello! This is the IfSunSets development team.
It has already been a month since our last update.
Since then, we have strapped on boosters and charged forward once again!
Check out what updates we have made and enjoy the fun gameplay.
Our game still has many issues, but we will never give up and continue to work hard to make it truly enjoyable!
We sincerely thank everyone who supports us and those who continue to enjoy our game.
We will keep pushing forward with more energy!

Thank you!

[/h3]There are some areas where the terrain has changed with this update.
After loading a saved file, you may find that your house is buried in rocks.
We were unable to consider this issue in this update.
Next time, we will make sure to take this into account when updating the terrain.
Also, if you set the visibility range too low while playing in a dungeon,
you might experience the walls or floors disappearing.
We have not yet completed the work to separate the walls and floors from the visibility settings.
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h1][Content][/h1]


[h2]Dungeon
[/h2]

A new desert dungeon has been created, featuring new rewards and new monsters!

[h3]Desert Dungeon
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/274304b9de7b9a89b7ba821cde014a19d1c7eec3.png[/img]
The cutscene for the final boss of the desert dungeon is still in production.
It will be included in a future update.


[h2]Castle Dungeon
[/h2]
A new castle dungeon has been created, featuring new rewards and new monsters!
Look forward to dungeon play filled with various traps and engaging stories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0a56e4a08b72ff03c9ea66517088b3767f38a0da.png[/img]


[h2]Ocean[/h2]
The Ocean Has Completely Changed!
We are actively working on our next update, the 'Marine Content'.
As part of this effort, we have prioritized updating the ocean, which will be the main stage for various marine content.
Check out the new items available for the marine content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/dc01fe9b6cb56f592f2dc2a5ad7dc2a3438af4cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/bbe46cbd3fa5c06b3bb24fdf9bcffbd14b8a431b.gif[/img]


[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
A tutorial quest has been created for new players starting the quest game.
Currently, only the tutorial quest is available, but
the next update will include a variety of other quests as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c4a459145dbfcc7c21acc6c3668dc0aaec42bcba.png[/img]


[h2]Interaction[/h2]
The system interaction method has completely changed!
If there are things to interact with nearby,
you can interact with the closest one to you.
When there are multiple objects, priority is given to the one closest to the crosshair.
Enjoy the game with this more convenient interaction system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/7729a5537eccfe70e477d36bf34adbf59e4a4b67.png[/img]


[h2]Boss Monster Renewal[/h2]
Our three major bosses, Brownbeard, Apophates, and Ironheart, have been completely revamped!
Play against the newly reborn bosses with new patterns and concepts!
I've managed to clear Brownbeard and Apophates, but I haven't beaten Ironheart yet...
[previewyoutube=kbfY3rxPkk4;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=tqwAe-cTm50;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=skwh7bRmoVY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Food and Buffs[/h2]
Food has been revamped, and various buffs have been added!
When you build a house, you can obtain various buffs by cooking and eating 'comfort' food available inside your home.
Additionally, health no longer recovers immediately unless you use a health potion.
However, if you eat until you're full and activate the 'satiety' buff, your health will gradually recover!
Foods that used to only satisfy hunger now come with their own unique buff effects.
Find the foods with the buffs that suit you best, and use various buffs to survive!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/048734a47635cf5e4f3469101481b7e12b44f35b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c1c459d0d2945522319e8536807c24d6359385d4.png[/img]


[h2]UI[/h2]
The UI has been revamped!
The UI will continue to improve in terms of convenience and design both now and in the future.
Look forward to a more stylish and user-friendly UI!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e8e07ee8a53afac0efe9186e3ab4f990f3b09a10.png[/img]


[h2]Feature: Arrow System[/h2]
Special arrows with unique abilities have been added to IfSunSets, which previously only had regular arrows!
Explosive arrows that deal damage to the surrounding area.
Electric arrows that slow down the movement speed of monsters.
Poison arrows that inflict continuous damage, among others.
Check out these various interesting arrows!
※ Bolts for crossbows will also be updated in the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ec4e81e45dba05f028e8487c8108020cb5a5bec1.png[/img]


[h2]New NPC[/h2]
A new NPC named 'Aiden' has arrived, sporting a cute bird on his head and a kind smile!
Aiden sells various farming-related items and cooking items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/3c157bf0dc4c808996565c5d21bc1a7c419fe90a.png[/img]



[h2]AI Overhaul[/h2]
Though still under detailed development, we have overhauled the AI that previously couldn’t detect arrows landing next to them.
The AI now has vision and hearing capabilities.
Activate crouch (C key) and approach monsters in a low stance!
If monsters aren’t directly looking at you, they won’t detect your presence.
However, if you’re not crouching or make loud noises, they will hear you and turn around, so be cautious!


[h2]Notes[/h2]
What secrets does this island hold?
Why did Ironheart come to this island?
What are the monsters that come at night?
Story notes that reveal various tales have been added!
Discover interesting stories scattered all around the island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ac1d6fa55a27a230ae1584a7e3654ec775283033.png[/img]


[h2]Glider[/h2]
The glider has been added!
While it's not a full-fledged airplane, you can soar high and enjoy the breathtaking views of the islands from above!
The blueprint for crafting the glider can be found somewhere on the island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c205f35868a8866573bf1fcf25553d3cd95a0bab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/8afa724e9836bffbf8e84267f56817a8473084cf.png[/img]


[h2]Mounts[/h2]
Mounts have been added!
They are sold by Lora and can be obtained after paying a hefty price.
Higher-tier mounts require even more gold and specific conditions to be met, so keep that in mind!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/c28f66e7a2d06bc6e5fd8e9083bfe6260c1fd554.png[/img]


[h2]Save System[/h2]
You can now save your game anytime, anywhere.
In a future update, we plan to support real-time saving for multiplayer (saving your current state when you exit the game).
The save function on beds has not been removed yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/a14c200edfa186a792a4742d91d712d45cf42f8c.png[/img]



[h2]Shared Chest[/h2]
The 'Shared Chest' system has been added to IfSunSets!
Only one shared chest can be placed in the world, and the materials inside the shared chest can be accessed by all workbenches!
Now gather materials and put them in the shared chest!
However, the shared chest is hidden somewhere on the island!
You'll have to find the shared chest first, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/9d7afabc85c3c1dc48a84b101ded4bd61cb4c146.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/0e86d227c78b1fd3ad65a060b30659891e7e17c1.png[/img]



[h2]Workbench Retrieval Function[/h2]
Now, workbenches can be retrieved!
Previously, many people found it difficult to move their homes because workbenches couldn't be retrieved.
With the retrieval function of the hammer, you can now retrieve all workbenches!
However, please remember that the contents inside the workbench will immediately pop out upon retrieval!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/b521f286c708cb48a3eb9d5e1327a2c3906e303d.png[/img]


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



[h1][Bug Fixes and Adjustments in Progress][/h1]

As new content has been created, many small bugs have been found in each content area.

We have fixed the visible bugs, but various other bugs may still occur in different situations.

We will address and fix all reported issues as quickly as possible.

However, considering the large file size of each update, we will resolve as many bugs as possible before proceeding with the updates!

In addition, the balance of the game is not yet perfectly refined due to the various new contents.

For example, some skills currently have a too wide range, and we plan to adjust this.

We are working on fine-tuning the balance,

and in the next update, we aim to deliver a more balanced gameplay experience.

Thank you.

The 'Ship Mallet' has been introduced, allowing you to craft various ships!
Use the ship mallet to build different types of boats!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/fecdc59a00cb56e77468b50451f21c6dbfdaa90f.png[/img]



[h2]Underwater AI Monsters[/h2]
The water is no longer safe...!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/66ec24722b0ec0830dba82b6d0f4ce2a0433bad1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/12f1c55ec68d78df0701fac52a47fb64889806cd.png[/img]



[h2]Stealth System[/h2]
A stealth system that activates when crouching has been designed.
It will be an essential feature for assassinations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/a97f29f14a136b0524e4ba1d5509d08bf98b4571.png[/img]



[h2]Multiplay[/h2]
Multiplay is coming soon!!!
We are working hard to add this feature as quickly as possible!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/ea04274c16a6a11189c3ccb77cd9a5c8027bd3e5.png[/img]

Thank You!

notes.title: [Update Note] 2024.02.29
notes.notes:
Hello,
This is the development team of IfSunset.

After about 20 days since February 8th, we are here to deliver the latest update news.
Currently, our top priority is developing multiplayer functionality. Although we are eager to present it to you as soon as possible, we are striving to provide a high-quality multiplayer experience by resolving various issues. We ask for your understanding as we put in extra effort towards achieving this goal.

We will continue to work diligently with unwavering passion until the end as the IfSunset development team!

Thank you!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Currently, there has been a significant increase in Fatal Errors on certain computer environments.

It seems that the problem occurs when pressing the game start button in fullscreen mode.
Changing to Window Mode in the settings window may temporarily resolve the issue.

We are currently investigating the cause of this problem.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
We will resolve this as soon as possible.

[previewyoutube=IpozMzBufWs;full][/previewyoutube]


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[b][h1][CONTENT UPDATE][/h1][/b]

- Mouse vertical and horizontal inversion options can now be set.

- A 'Resurrection After Death' button has been added, allowing respawning with a penalty in case of getting stuck in the menu.

- A notification prompt now appears at the beginning of the game asking whether to adjust settings according to hardware performance.
(This notification only appears once after the update and won't show up afterwards.)

- An item grading system has been implemented. Weapons and armor items are now graded as rudimentary, good, or excellent, affecting their stats and maximum upgrade levels.

- Monsters now drop weapons and armor.

- Special attributes have been added to armor pieces according to their body parts.

- The dash pattern during boss fights has been adjusted to activate only when the player is sufficiently far from the boss.

- A new feature to display preset equipped items has been added to the customization menu.

- If ceiling modules can support roof modules, they can now be installed accordingly.

- A toggle button has been added to the helmet UI to show/hide helmets.

- Success probability for equipment enhancement is now displayed.

- Trying to enter the shop before obtaining Laura now prompts a message stating that the shop cannot be accessed yet.

- Traps can now be installed on the foundation for various strategies.

- Fairy dialogue has been added.

- Food and cooking recipes have been added to the catalogue.

- Obtaining the cooking catalogue now allows viewing of recipes.

- An option to toggle the Shift sprinting feature on/off has been added to the settings menu.

- Zoom-in and rotation functions have been added to the customization window.

- Uncooked recipes are now marked with '?' when cooking.

- Boxes can now be stacked on top of each other.

- Stats not previously displayed in tooltips are now shown.

- Material names are now displayed when upgrading workbenches.

- Several windows can now be closed using the Esc key.

- Shark teeth have been added to drop items.

- The stamina bar has been redesigned.

- Eating speed with 'E' key has been decreased 
(to 1/5 of the current speed).

- Right-clicking on storage now stores items, while Alt + right-clicking places items into the hotbar.

- Selecting 'Combat' in the attribute menu now visibly shows the selected option.

- Weapon types such as two-handed swords, one-handed swords, etc., are now displayed.

- Spawn point hint text has been changed due to player confusion.

- The size of the hot bar has been increased.

- Durability of modules is now displayed when constructing buildings.

- A message indicating insufficient materials now appears when construction cannot proceed.

- Tutorial messages now disappear after 1 minute.

- UIs can now be closed by pressing Esc.

- Items inside destroyed containers now spill out instead of disappearing.

- Drop box containers can now be destroyed, releasing contained items.

- Durability of objects is now visible when repairing buildings.

- Fairy messages upon death now appear only once.

- Service treasure chests like Brown Bearded or Apotheosis now appear in Ironheart.

- Environment lighting has been adjusted.

- Wild cabbage has been added.




------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[b][h1][BALANCING][/h1][/b]

- Skill points have been balanced.

- The maximum enhancement limit for equipment has been changed from +3 to +5.

- A level limit has been applied to the enhancement anvil. The level limit can be unlocked through an anvil upgrade. (Example: Anvil Tier 1: Only up to +2 enhancements are possible)

- To emphasize the significance of consecutive attacks, damage is now added when performing consecutive attacks.

- The balance of monsters and items has been adjusted.

- The HP of monsters has been generally increased.

- The balance of floor traps has been adjusted.
Durability: 500 -> 400
Increased required materials
Increased crafting time
Repair now requires planks

- Laura now sells seeds and watering cans.

- The skill point requirement for Goddess of Luck has been changed from 1 to 5.

- The durability of spike traps and spike walls has been increased.

- The respawn time of elk and rabbits has been changed.

- The required number of wooden logs for repairing spike walls and trap types has been changed from 1 to 2.

- The required number of wooden logs for crafting traps has been increased.

[h1][Update Note 2024.01.05]
[/h1]
The demo has been updated.

This update includes a lot of new content.

We appreciate all the feedback that has contributed to this update.

Looking forward to your continued play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/e71ba2906fc6ddfafbb534d4edc7e36dcd408c08.jpg[/img]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h3][Prioritized Notice]
[/h3]
1) Multiplay will not be available in this update.
The demo has been updated with a lot of new content. 
While the number of occurring bugs has increased, we've tried to figure out as many as possible. 
However, due to the added content, numerous issues have arisen in multiplay. 
Until these issues are stabilized, multiplay will be unavailable. 
We will work hard to reopen multiplay as soon as possible. 
Multiplay is a core feature of our game, and we will make sure to complete it without giving up.


2) The first-person view system has been removed.
We’ve decided that first-person view mode requires a significant amount of animation fixes. 
While the first-person view mode is a good idea as a separate content, 
there is a challenge in unifying animations such as attacks and actions with the third-person view. 
As we continue to modify the animations for the third-person view mode,
the first-person view mode will be removed from our game until this issue is resolved. 
It will be reintroduced internally after the early access release.


3) The book system has been removed.
We initially thought that allowing players to record many things through books and having them fill out the books would be interesting. 
However, we found that even when we played, 
the book system wasn't engaging at all and, in fact, 
made the gameplay more tedious. As a result, 
we have removed the book system and replaced it with NPCs. 
Check out the NPCs that will grow and evolve with you in all aspects.


4) We plan to upload a trailer video featuring the mentioned changes from January 8th to January 12th. 
The current trailer includes several elements that were developed before but are no longer in use. 
We believe that this could confuse players who later experience our game. 
Although we initially intended to update the trailer at the time of the early access release, 
our plans have changed, and we will now upload the trailer video from January 8th to January 12th.

5) The save files from the previous version are not compatible with the latest version. 
Using old save data may result in unexpected bugs. We apologize for any inconvenience. 
Please create a new character to enjoy the demo.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[h2][Update Contents]
[/h2]
1) Construction Method Change
- We have revamped the existing construction method.
- Now you can build structures using materials such as leaves, wood, stone, iron, gold, and Cthugha's stones.

2) UI Improvement
- We have redesigned the UI and added various new features.
- The HUD design indicating player status has been changed.
- The map design has been updated.

3) Disassembly System
- Now you can eat, disassemble, and discard items directly from the inventory.
- Activate the context menu with SHIFT + right-click.

4) Day / Field Monsters Added and Improved
- 10 preemptive attack monsters, including pirates, giants, witches, wild boars, crocodiles, and more, have been added.
- 7 non-aggressive animals, such as crab, squirrels, lizards, rabbits, etc., have been added.

5) Night / Wave Monsters Added and Improved
- Three monsters with the appearance of marine creatures have been added.
- As time passes and you deal with waves, more dangerous monsters will spawn.

6) Cooking System Improvement
- The cooking pot has been improved to function properly.
- More cooking recipes have been added.
- The effects of cooking have been enhanced. Build a cooking pot and try various recipes.

7) NPC Addition
- NPCs are scattered throughout the world, seeking your help.
- If you rescue them, they will take on the role of a trader.
- Currently, there are a total of 5 NPCs.
- They don't say much at the moment, as their functionality has been implemented. 
Over time, more developments and conversations will be possible.

8) The Encyclopedia System has been added.
- Collect items and unlock them one by one.
- We are planning rewards for each completion of the encyclopedia.

9) Blueprint System Added
- Acquire blueprints to craft new items.
- Blueprints can be collected in the world or obtained from traders if you're lucky.

10) Altar System Improvement
- Altars can now be used as teleportation devices.

11) Temperature System
- Still needs a lot of improvement, but we have started testing the temperature system.

12) Pollution System
- A pollution system has been developed that prevents health regeneration and reduces maximum health.
- As the character dies and uses Cthugha's Stones, pollution increases.
- There might be NPCs in the world that can help recover from pollution.

13) Item Collection Method Change
- The method of collecting items has been altered.
- Trees remain the same, but the falling animation has been removed.
- Rocks remain the same, but items now automatically go into the inventory without picking them up.
- Collectible items can be obtained by holding down the E key. They will automatically go into the inventory while holding the key.
- Chests can now be opened by holding down the E key, and the interaction time increases based on the grade. They open immediately once the interaction is complete.

14) Boss Battle Improvement and Boss-Related Content Addition
- Fixed a bug where rolling in front of boss monsters would cause characters to bounce.
- Improved awkward animations when boss monsters rotate.
- Adjusted the balance of boss monsters.
- You can't challenge boss monsters at any time. You must offer Cthugha's Stone and solve puzzles to initiate the challenge.
- Each boss monster now has its own cutscene.
- After defeating a boss, you can absorb unknown power from the artifact guarded by the boss monster.
- Fixed a bug where characters could pass through the ground at the location of the octopus boss monster.

15) Fishing System Added
- A new fishing system has been added as a mini-game for players to enjoy.
- Fishing allows you to obtain various types of fish.
- Fish can be sold, and they are divided into different grades.
- Currently, there is only one type of fishing rod.
- Stay tuned for further developments in the fishing feature.

16) Graphic Update
- Improved environmental graphics.
- Enhanced lighting to create a more pronounced global illumination during the day.
- Completed the initial phase of fixing collision errors across the environment.
- Several new locations have been added.
- A new shop has been introduced.
- The castle has undergone a transformation.

17) Background Music Addition and Sound Effects Improvement
- Added background music that varies according to different situations.
- Background music changes depending on normal battle situations, boss battles, day, dangerous night, and safe night.
- Fixed a bug where sounds were audible from a distance.
- Improved the sound of monsters.

18) Various Environment Setting Improvements
- Resolved issues with settings that were not being applied.
- Adjusting the screen percentage gauge can now save a considerable amount of frames.
- It is automatically adjusted according to your specifications, and you can manually adjust it through the settings after starting the game.
- Improved the environment settings window to stay within the aspect ratio of a 1:1 monitor resolution.

19) Camera Improvement
- Adjusted the camera perspective.
- Fixed an issue where the camera would go through walls.
- During boss battles, the camera now zooms out further.

20) MonsterWave Improvement
- Adjusted the difficulty while maintaining the number of wave monsters.
- Changed the duration of the dangerous night to approximately 5 minutes and 30 seconds in real-time.
- Fixed a bug related to monster evaporation.
- Resolved an issue where monsters were not spawning frequently.
- Fixed a bug where monsters were getting stuck in walls.
- Addressed an issue where wave monsters were spawning in mid-air.

21) Fairy System Added
- A new companion has joined you.
- The fairy grows using your skill points.
- The fairy will replace tutorial messages.
- The fairy attempts to attack along with you when you attack.
- Many aspects are still incomplete (even the appearance). We will quickly address feedback for this new system.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



[h1][Post-January 5th Update Plans]
[/h1]

[h2][Regarding Content]
[/h2]
1) Boss Battle Addition
- A new boss monster, 'Shark,' is scheduled to be added.
- Asset and animation work has been completed, but it is still in progress from a functional perspective.

2) Story-Related Item Addition
(Adding Notes and NPC Dialogues)
- We plan to introduce notes scattered throughout the field, which players can collect from various locations and read.
- These notes and NPC dialogues aim to provide insights into the game world's lore and share small, meaningful stories with the players.

3) Adding Maritime Battle
- We are planning to introduce maritime content as preparation for the final content in IfSunset.
- It's currently in the planning stage, and we haven't entered the production phase yet.
- However, this is the crucial content that will definitely be added.

4) Adding Final Boss Battle (Kraken Battle)
- Upon the addition of maritime battles, we plan to immediately design the final battle with the Kraken.
- The Kraken is intended to be the ultimate boss battle in IfSunset and is scheduled to be the concluding fight in the game's story.

5) Adding Multiplayer
- Multiplayer is one of the core contents in IfSunset.
- However, as we are developing and working on it without a dedicated server developer, it may take some time.

6) Adding Various Weapons
(Javelin, Mace, Automatic Crossbow)

7) Adding Electrical Devices
(Blade Trap, Electric Wire Trap, Electric Lantern)
- We have created electrical devices commonly seen in survival games utilizing the energy of 'Cthugha's Stone.' 
- We are currently planning and developing additional electrical devices that utilize the electrical system.

8) Adding Wearable Lantern
- We are planning to add a wearable lantern that will illuminate dark areas.

9) Adding Construction Modules
- We are planning to create additional construction modules to enhance the freedom of construction beyond the current options.

10) New Adding Fishing Rod, Bait
- We are planning and developing systems such as high-quality fishing rods and bait attachments to allow for a more diverse and enjoyable fishing experience.

11) Adding Wave and Field Monsters
(Swimming Monster, Flying Monster, Ranged Monster)
- We are planning to add more monsters for a fun and challenging night experience.

12) Adding Treasure Map Event
A treasure map obtained through NPC quests, farming, or purchasing from a store.
When using the treasure map →
A marker is displayed on the map →
Upon reaching the location, there may be tricks or treasures →
Interacting with the treasure spawns monsters →
Defeating them allows you to obtain the treasure.

13) Event Utilizing Night-only Objects
- We have completed the creation of special, brightly shining environmental objects that only appear at night.
- Similar to a "Only Up!," there is a chance to obtain high-grade items when reaching the top without falling.

14) Adding Interactive Water
- We are planning to add water with waves and ripples, creating an interactive water feature.

15) Adding Modes
(Healing Mode, PK Mode, Simulation Mode)
- We are designing various modes tailored to player preferences.
- Healing Mode: A mode focused on life-related content such as construction, farming, fishing, and gardening, with no monsters or waves.
- PK Mode: An arcade-style mode that initiates player-versus-player battles on a new map.
- Simulation Mode: A mode for experimenting and experiencing various waves in different ways.

16) Adding Unique Functions for Each NPC
- We plan to significantly expand additional functions and dialogues for each NPC, which are currently somewhat uniform.
- Example: Dwarves will now be able to repair the equipment you desire.

17) Boss Battle Wave Event
- After hunting a boss and destroying the gem behind it, the next night, you won't be able to use the altar, and the minions of that boss will emerge as wave monsters.

18) Flag Item Addition
- While the map marker feature is implemented, there is a discussion about whether to make it freely available or require crafting an item to place markers on the map.

19) Extensive Customization Elements Added
- We plan to add a wide variety of customization materials, allowing players to create their own unique characters with more options.




[h2][Improvement-related Content]
[/h2]

1) Reflecting feedback and making adjustments for the demo.

2) Fixing internal bugs that have emerged.

3) Improving the texture modeling of fairies.

4) Balancing debugging in progress.

5) Field monster AI improvement.

6) Large-scale optimization of modeling and textures in progress.

7) Large-scale optimization of systems in progress.

8) Improvement in environmental collision underway.

9) Sound (sound effects) improvement in progress.

10) Tutorial improvement in progress.




[h2][ Multiplay ]
[/h2]

1) Multiplay addition and debugging in progress.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Thank you!

notes.title: We're excited to announce the release of our latest demo version!
notes.notes:
Hello! This is the 'IfSunSets' development team.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/329338a5c342c6ca3a14302101366ccc54ee7e18.png[/img]
We're excited to announce the release of our latest demo version! To update, please log in to the Steam app again. If the update doesn't work, you can simply uninstall the demo and download it again.

[u][b]***Please delete the existing demo and reinstall the new demo.***
***The default language is Korean.
Enter the settings tab as shown in the image and change to the desired language.***[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578563/95bd1548630ee20e177432b65ff8ec34e22bc5f9.png[/img]

To receive the update, delete the demo and download it again.

We want to express our sincere apologies and gratitude to those who have been patiently waiting. We are committed to continuing updates until we reach our Early Access goals, even if it takes weeks or months. We hope you'll continue to look forward to the evolving 'IfSunSets.'

Key updates in this release include:

Significant background work
Changes to level design
Changes to tutorial quests
Major changes to the combat system
Lighting adjustments
Modeling optimization
Texture optimization
LOD and Nanite optimization
Animation optimization
Addition of over 100 items
Addition of a cooking system (beta)
Addition of a multiplayer system (beta)
Changes to the skill system
Changes to the settings system
Changes to map design
Addition of female characters
Major animation changes
Item balancing (beta)
Work on changing effects
Boss battle animation adjustments

The highlight of this update is the completely redesigned level design and the introduction of the multiplayer system. However, please note that the multiplayer feature is currently in a very unstable state, and we ask for your understanding in this regard.

Once again, we want to express our heartfelt thanks to those who have been patiently waiting. We will continue to work hard to make 'IfSunSets' more optimized, upgraded, and true to the gaming experience.
